title: Output-buffer rewind
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of the four-tape interpreter on input $x$. For Boolean words $b$ and $o$, and a natural number $j$ with $j\leq |c.output|$, start the timed interpreter in its output-buffer rewind phase, with clock word $b$, the output buffer initialized from $c.output$ and its head at position $j-1$, and real output $o$. After $j+1$ steps it is in the flush phase with the buffer head at position $0$ and real output $o$ followed by the bit $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a four-tape interpreter configuration on input $x$
replaced:
For every $j$ at most the buffered output's length, from the buffer-rewind
phase with the buffer head at $j-1$, exactly $j+1$ steps of the timed
interpreter reach the flush phase with the buffer head at $0$, emitting the
success tag $1$ at the left blank before any data bit.
